tasks.title: Atomic root noindex shell with centralized root policy
tasks.end_state: A code-owned ROOT_ROUTE_POLICY ({path:'/', visibility:'noindex'}) lives in src/lib/routes.ts and is consumed by src/pages/sitemap.xml.ts (excluded from discovery while noindex; Plan 04 promotes the same policy). src/pages/index.astro renders directly as a complete standards-mode document: doctype, html lang, charset, zoom-safe viewport, title, description, one canonical https://example.com/, noindex,follow meta, basic OG (title/description/type/url), Skip to content link, main#main, exactly one h1 with approved identity copy only, no script. The verifier CLI manifest expects / as an html route (not discoverable), endpoints stay sitemap.xml+robots.txt, allowEmptySitemap: true. No SeoHead/BaseLayout yet (B2 extracts them). No Home Markdown record.
tasks.files_note: Declared 5-file cohesive exception: the atomic root activation requires the centralized root policy, the sitemap discovery wiring, the page, the verifier manifest update, and the new isolated-build test harness to land in one GREEN boundary so every gate passes. tasks.title: Shared no-JS head, layout, and visibility-safe header
tasks.end_state: SeoHead.astro (typed props: title, description, canonicalPath?, noindex) renders canonical via canonicalHref(canonicalPath ?? Astro.url.pathname, Astro.site.href) and exact noindex,follow robots + basic OG. BaseLayout.astro provides standards-mode document, head via SeoHead, skip link, SiteHeader, one main#main with slot, and structural CSS (no brand tokens, no motion). SiteHeader.astro calls getEntry('settings','site') for labels (missing record throws, no silent fallback), getCollection('pages') to build the visibility map, resolveRoutes to keep only routable paths in NAV_ORDER, prepends the ROOT_ROUTE link, renders exactly one nav aria-label=Primary with aria-current=page on the active route, emits no links to absent/draft routes, no JS toggle. index.astro is refactored to use BaseLayout while preserving B1's metadata, identity copy, root policy, and noindex behavior. No client script.
tasks.files_note: Declared 5-file cohesive exception: extracting metadata/layout and adding the header are a cohesive shell-chrome unit sharing the index refactor and one test file. Approved per .opencode/command/plan.md:340-373.

tasks.title: Shared footer and recoverable 404 page
